_comment: Growth-only corpus manifest for the backup-format archaeology lane (umbrella #842 W1.4). `formats` lists every backup snapshot format the corpus covers; it MUST include every string in packages/backup manifest READABLE_SNAPSHOT_FORMATS so a format bump forces a new corpus member. Never remove a format. `expectedCensus` is the plaintext census a sealed-then-restored member must show. NOTE: today's format ('centraid-snapshot/2') is pre-release and the only readable AND writable format, so the lane seals a live member and restores it with today's code. When the format graduates to maintaining backward read-compat across a bump, a member for the older format is added here (as frozen bytes or a size-bounded fixture) and kept forever.
